رببت (form I)
# رَبَبْتُ (rababtu) /ra.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of رَبَّ (rabba)
# رَبَبْتَ (rababta) /ra.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of رَبَّ (rabba)
# رَبَبْتِ (rababti) /ra.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of رَبَّ (rabba)
# رُبِبْتُ (rubibtu) /ru.bib.tu/: first-person singular past passive of رَبَّ (rabba)
# رُبِبْتَ (rubibta) /ru
